worldcombat.skill.substitute.summary: Spend part of your own max HP to raise a body double nearby; its durability is a multiple of the HP actually paid. It absorbs attacks aimed at you only within link range and with a clear line — stepping out only pauses the protection until you return — until it is shattered or its time runs out.
worldcombat.skill.substitute.description: Pay %1$s of your max HP to form a substitute; its durability is %2$s times the HP actually paid.

The double is placed within %1$s blocks of you; it takes hits for you while it stays within %2$s blocks and has a clear line to you, so stepping out of link range only pauses that until you return. It lasts at most %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.substitute.timing: %1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.substitute.use.0: Raise a blood shield before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.substitute.use.1: Pull a lethal volley onto the double
worldcombat.skill.substitute.use.2: Trade some HP for room to reset when hurt
Above this health fraction the double is not raised on purpose. The default 1.0 raises it as soon as a threat appears; lower values save HP for other plans and only raise it once hurt.
The fraction that must remain after paying; higher is more cautious and simply refuses the cast when unaffordable.
Whether the double stands between the user and the threat or near its owner; the two placements answer enemies from different directions.
When on, the user may step aside to raise the double even while holding a station; when off it only casts what it can reach in place.
world_combat.move.substitute.text.weak: Too little HP; the substitute failed
worldcombat.skill.substitute.description: Cannot be used while a double exists. HP after payment must exceed %1$s of maximum HP, following the reserve-health preference. If placement fails, the HP paid is refunded.
